label: ZKN_SHIELD_001_000
text:
While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are
stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_002_000
text:
Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength.
Sunlight also makes the bud on its back
grow larger.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_003_000
text:
A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.
The fragrance becalms those engaged
in a battle.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_004_000
text:
From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip
of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to
go out.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_005_000
text:
If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts
intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_006_000
text:
Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an
altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very
high temperatures.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_007_000
text:
When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside
its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_008_000
text:
It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to
maintain its balance while swimming.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_009_000
text:
The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water
capable of punching holes through thick steel.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_010_000
text:
Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that
enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_011_000
text:
Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell,
the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a
harsh attack.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_012_000
text:
It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto
the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_000
text:
When Pikachu meet, they’ll touch their tails
together and exchange electricity through them
as a form of greeting.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_026_000
text:
If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail
to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_027_000
text:
It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If
hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp
claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_028_000
text:
It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws.
Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping
them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_029_000
text:
It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat
berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a
bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_030_000
text:
If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will
band together to assault enemies with a chorus
of ultrasonic waves.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_031_000
text:
It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps
between the spines on its back. The spines will
never secrete poison while young are present.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_032_000
text:
Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its
ground and even risk its life in battle to protect
the female it’s friendly with.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_033_000
text:
It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively.
The potency of its poison increases along with
the level of adrenaline present in its body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_034_000
text:
Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful
and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail
and diamond-crushing horn.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_035_000
text:
Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular.
However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_036_000
text:
Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin
drop from over a mile away, so they’re usually
found in quiet places.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_037_000
text:
As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous.
When held, it feels slightly warm.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_038_000
text:
Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of
its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_039_000
text:
By freely changing the wavelength of its voice,
Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to
make any listener sleepy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_040_000
text:
It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate.
In particular, the curl on its forehead has a
texture that’s perfectly heavenly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_041_000
text:
Zubat live in caves, down where the sun’s light
won’t reach. In the morning, they gather together
to keep each other warm as they sleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_042_000
text:
Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully.
It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its
fangs and slurping up blood.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_043_000
text:
During the day, it stays in the cold underground
to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_044_000
text:
What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey.
It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_045_000
text:
The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it
contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_050_000
text:
It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth.
It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy
to spot.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_051_000
text:
These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea
level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_052_000
text:
It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on
its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with
Galarian Meowth.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_053_000
text:
Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that
of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship
between the two is one of mutual disdain.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_054_000
text:
As Psyduck gets stressed out, its headache gets
progressively worse. It uses intense psychic
energy to overwhelm those around it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_055_000
text:
Old tales tell of Golduck punishing those that
defiled its river. The guilty were dragged into
the water and taken away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_058_000
text:
Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any
opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_059_000
text:
A Pokémon that has long been admired for its
beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_060_000
text:
In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will
cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act
like a suction cup.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_061_000
text:
This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When
captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’
grasp and escape.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_062_000
text:
Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial
arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out
powerful punches.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_063_000
text:
Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently
the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its
teleportations go.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_064_000
text:
This Pokémon’s telekinesis is immensely powerful.
To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up
psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_065_000
text:
Alakazam wields potent psychic powers. It’s said
that this Pokémon used these powers to create
the spoons it holds.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_066_000
text:
Always brimming with power, it passes time by
lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_067_000
text:
Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps
people by doing work such as the moving of
heavy goods.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_068_000
text:
With four arms that react more quickly than it
can think, it can execute many punches at once.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_072_000
text:
This Pokémon is mostly made of water.
A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to
spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_073_000
text:
Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely.
Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out
tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_077_000
text:
If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning
mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_078_000
text:
The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it
decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_079_000
text:
When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water,
sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait
to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_080_000
text:
Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon
into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go,
it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_081_000
text:
It subsists on electricity. As Magnemite flies, it
emits electromagnetic waves from the units on
each side of its body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_082_000
text:
This Pokémon is constantly putting out a powerful
magnetic force. Most computers go haywire when
a Magneton approaches.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_083_000
text:
They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all
of them use it in the same way. Several distinct
styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_090_000
text:
Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is
vulnerable only when its shell is open.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_091_000
text:
Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to
open, even by those with superior strength.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_092_000
text:
With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place
it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_093_000
text:
If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness
when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_094_000
text:
It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the
lives of those who become lost in mountains.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_095_000
text:
It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by
squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_098_000
text:
If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself
with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_099_000
text:
Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s
not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_102_000
text:
These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a
group of six. The minute even one member of the
group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_103_000
text:
When they work together, Exeggutor’s three
heads can put out powerful psychic energy.
Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_104_000
text:
This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased
mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry,
but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_105_000
text:
When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its
mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also
turned vicious at the same time.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_106_000
text:
The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy
legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_107_000
text:
Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to
need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_108_000
text:
Bug Pokémon are Lickitung’s main food source.
This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from
its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_109_000
text:
It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing
used to be more plentiful in the Galar region
than they are now.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_110_000
text:
It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian
Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more
potent than those of its counterpart.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_111_000
text:
It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it
starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_112_000
text:
Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of
living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_113_000
text:
This species was once very slow. To protect their
eggs from other creatures, these Pokémon
became able to flee quickly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_114_000
text:
The vines of a Tangela have a distinct scent.
In some parts of Galar, Tangela vines are used
as herbs.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_115_000
text:
There are records of a lost human child being
raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_116_000
text:
They swim with dance-like motions and cause
whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which
of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_117_000
text:
Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power
is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food
that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_118_000
text:
Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed
like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_119_000
text:
Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed
boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from
washing away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_120_000
text:
Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t
bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even
if part of it is completely torn off.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_121_000
text:
Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed.
As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it
absorbs tiny plankton.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_122_000
text:
It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills.
It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by
emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_123_000
text:
If you come across an area in a forest where a lot
of the trees have been cut down, what you’ve
found is a Scyther’s territory.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_124_000
text:
The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and
delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have
even gathered a fan base.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_125_000
text:
With the coming of a storm, many of these
Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there
waiting for lightning to strike.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_126_000
text:
These Pokémon’s bodies are constantly burning.
Magmar are feared as one of the causes
behind fires.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_127_000
text:
This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey
and then either splits the prey in half or flings
it away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_128_000
text:
The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in
nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on
their backs.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_129_000
text:
This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets easily
pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_130_000
text:
Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn
everything down, even in a harsh storm.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_131_000
text:
Crossing icy seas is no issue for this
cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin
is a little cool to the touch.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_132_000
text:
When it encounters another Ditto, it will move
faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_133_000
text:
Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this
special Pokémon conceals many different
possible evolutions.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_134_000
text:
Its body’s cellular structure is similar to the
molecular composition of water. It can melt
invisibly in water.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_135_000
text:
It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to
blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_136_000
text:
It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal
flame pouch, which heats it to over
3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_137_000
text:
In recent years, this species has been very helpful
in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around
checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_138_000
text:
This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct
species. Omanyte paddles through water with its
10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_139_000
text:
Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the
Pokémon can attack only the prey that come
within reach of its tentacles.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_140_000
text:
While some say this species has gone extinct,
Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common
in some places.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_141_000
text:
The cause behind the extinction of this species is
unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon
that inhabited warm seas.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_142_000
text:
Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to
tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_143_000
text:
This Pokémon’s stomach is so strong, even eating
moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_144_000
text:
This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno
is said to live in snowy mountains riddled
with permafrost.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_145_000
text:
Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said
that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together,
lightning will fall immediately after.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_146_000
text:
There are stories of this Pokémon using its
radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths
for those lost in the mountains.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_147_000
text:
This Pokémon was long considered to be no
more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s
forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_148_000
text:
This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its
tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded
by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_149_000
text:
This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate.
Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate
the bows of many ships.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_150_000
text:
The research efforts of a certain scientist
ultimately resulted in this Pokémon.
Its powers are dedicated to battling.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_151_000
text:
This mythical Pokémon is said to be extinct, but
sightings of it are still being reported to this day.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_163_000
text:
It begins to hoot at the same time every day.
Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_164_000
text:
When it needs to think, it rotates its head
180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_169_000
text:
This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully.
Crobat can fly through cramped caves without
needing to slow down.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_170_000
text:
On the dark ocean floor, its only means of
communication is its constantly flashing lights.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_171_000
text:
This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds
its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver
an electrical attack.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_172_000
text:
The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a
little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_173_000
text:
Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people
believe that it came here on a meteor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_174_000
text:
Taking advantage of the softness of its body,
Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a
deep pink when its temperature rises.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_175_000
text:
It is considered to be a symbol of good luck.
Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_176_000
text:
It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people.
It can float in midair without moving its wings.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_177_000
text:
Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to
hop to get around. It is always staring
at something.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_178_000
text:
This odd Pokémon can see both the past and
the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_182_000
text:
Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance.
They say that the dance is a ritual to summon
the sun.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_183_000
text:
Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water-
repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves
the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_184_000
text:
These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When
Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them
with these bubbles.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_185_000
text:
It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates
water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_186_000
text:
The cry of a male is louder than that of a female.
Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find
more popularity with the opposite gender.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_194_000
text:
When walking on land, it covers its body with a
poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_195_000
text:
Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head
on the river bottom as it swims but seems not
to care.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_196_000
text:
It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its
forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb
grows dull and dark.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_197_000
text:
On the night of a full moon, or when it gets
excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_199_000
text:
Slowking can solve any problem presented to it,
but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_202_000
text:
To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly
in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_206_000
text:
The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels.
They never get lost in their own nests—they can
tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_208_000
text:
It is thought its body transformed as a result of
iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_211_000
text:
The small spikes covering its body developed
from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_212_000
text:
Though its body is slim, Scizor has tremendous
attacking power. Even Scizor’s muscles are made
of metal.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_213_000
text:
The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually
become a thick, pulpy juice.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_214_000
text:
This Pokémon takes pride in its strength, which
allows it to lift things 100 times heavier than
itself with no trouble at all.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_215_000
text:
It has a cunning yet savage disposition.
It waits for parents to leave their nests,
and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_220_000
text:
If it smells something enticing, it dashes off
headlong to find the source of the aroma.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_221_000
text:
Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves
prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_222_000
text:
These Pokémon live in warm seas.
In prehistoric times, many lived in the
oceans around the Galar region as well.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_223_000
text:
Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a
Mantine’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_224_000
text:
It traps enemies with its suction-cupped
tentacles, then smashes them with its
rock-hard head.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_225_000
text:
It has a generous habit of sharing its food with
people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging
around for more food.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_226_000
text:
As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if
Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_227_000
text:
People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed
feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element
in heraldic designs.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_230_000
text:
Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a
splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been
given to royalty as gifts.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_233_000
text:
After artificial intelligence was implemented in
Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange
language that only other Porygon2 understand.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_236_000
text:
Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because
it will slug any handy target without warning.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_237_000
text:
After doing a handstand to throw off the
opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_238_000
text:
This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum
decides what it likes and dislikes by touching
things with its lips.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_239_000
text:
It’s not good at storing electricity yet. This
Pokémon sneaks into people’s homes, looking
for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_240_000
text:
This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes.
At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma,
resting and recovering from the day’s fatigue.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_241_000
text:
This Pokémon needs to be milked every day,
or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk
changes with the seasons.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_242_000
text:
Blissey lays mysterious eggs that are filled with
happiness. It’s said that anyone who eats a
Blissey egg will start acting kindly to all others.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_246_000
text:
It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large
mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_247_000
text:
It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa.
It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_248_000
text:
The quakes caused when it walks make even
great mountains crumble and change
the surrounding terrain.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_251_000
text:
This Pokémon traveled through time to come
from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with
its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_263_000
text:
Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside
Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost
something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_264_000
text:
It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws
to bring down prey. Running along winding
paths is not its strong suit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_270_000
text:
Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land.
That is how it began to live floating in the water.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_271_000
text:
It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny.
It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and
becomes active at night.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_272_000
text:
If it hears festive music, it begins moving in
rhythm in order to amplify its power.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_273_000
text:
It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of
its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_274_000
text:
They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound
of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_275_000
text:
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to
create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_278_000
text:
It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings.
It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_279_000
text:
Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill
in the sea, scoops up food and water, and
carries it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_280_000
text:
If its horns capture the warm feelings of people
or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_281_000
text:
It has a psychic power that enables it to distort
the space around it and see into the future.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_282_000
text:
To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic
power to create a small black hole.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_290_000
text:
It can sometimes live underground for more than
10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots
of trees.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_291_000
text:
This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to
avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_292_000
text:
A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its
wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does
not breathe.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_293_000
text:
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice
startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder.
It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_294_000
text:
The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just
the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that
blows opponents away and damages them.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_295_000
text:
This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To
communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all
sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_298_000
text:
Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry
one will swing around the big ball on its tail and
try to smash its opponents.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_302_000
text:
It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its
eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_303_000
text:
It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are
actually steel horns that have been transformed.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_304_000
text:
When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In
ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed
armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_305_000
text:
During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by
slamming into each other. Close inspection of
their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_306_000
text:
Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet
meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He
was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_309_000
text:
It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks
from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_310_000
text:
It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest
where lightning has fallen.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_315_000
text:
It uses the different poisons in each hand
separately when it attacks. The stronger its
aroma, the healthier it is.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_318_000
text:
These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful
jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_319_000
text:
This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea.
Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls
home will be attacked—no exceptions.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_320_000
text:
When it sucks in a large volume of seawater,
it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton
of food daily.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_321_000
text:
Its immense size is the reason for its popularity.
Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing
activity in various parts of the world.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_324_000
text:
You find abandoned coal mines full of them.
They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_328_000
text:
It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in
wait at the bottom for prey to come
tumbling down.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_329_000
text:
To help make its wings grow, it dissolves
quantities of prey in its digestive juices and
guzzles them down every day.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_330_000
text:
It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the
flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_333_000
text:
Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can
have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings
turned white over many generations.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_334_000
text:
This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s
provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill
cries before attacking them without mercy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_337_000
text:
It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike
40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_338_000
text:
Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is
strong during the daytime. When it spins, its
body shines.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_339_000
text:
It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long
whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_340_000
text:
It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes
near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_341_000
text:
It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped
to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_342_000
text:
A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will
crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_343_000
text:
It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving,
it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even
when asleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_344_000
text:
It appears to have been born from clay dolls
made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to
float and move.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_345_000
text:
Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey
comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with
petallike tentacles.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_346_000
text:
Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles,
it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_347_000
text:
Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings
through the water like oars on a boat. This
Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_348_000
text:
Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer.
It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its
sharp claws to take down its quarry.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_349_000
text:
It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is
very hardy and can survive on little water.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_350_000
text:
It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty
will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_355_000
text:
Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to
prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_356_000
text:
It seeks drifting will-o’-the-wisps and sucks them
into its empty body. What happens inside is
a mystery.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_359_000
text:
Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect
danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer
of doom.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_360_000
text:
It tends to move in a pack with others.
They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_361_000
text:
It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces
happily around, even in environments as cold as
−150 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_362_000
text:
It can instantly freeze moisture in the
atmosphere. It uses this power to freeze its foes.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_363_000
text:
As it drifts among the waves, Spheal probes
the sea. As soon as it spots prey, it informs the
Walrein in its herd.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_364_000
text:
This Pokémon has a habit of spinning round
things on its nose, whether those things are
Poké Balls or Spheal.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_365_000
text:
Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life.
Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their
usual impressive size in a year.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_369_000
text:
This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea
exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in
100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_371_000
text:
Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form
groups with others of its kind. It also has a head
hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_372_000
text:
Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating
any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once
all its energy stores are used up.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_373_000
text:
While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps
this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into
an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_374_000
text:
The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed
of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic
forces flow through Beldum’s body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_375_000
text:
Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon
flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh
mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_376_000
text:
Metagross is the result of the fusion of two
Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents
through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_377_000
text:
Cutting-edge technology was used to study
the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but
nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_378_000
text:
This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s
said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in
the ice age.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_379_000
text:
It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep
underground in the planet’s mantle and that it
emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_385_000
text:
It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from
its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes
written on the notes attached to its head.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_403_000
text:
Electricity makes this Pokémon’s fur glow. Shinx
sends signals to others of its kind by shaking the
tip of its tail while the tail tip is shining brightly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_404_000
text:
Upon encountering an opponent, this Pokémon
prepares for battle by extending its claws, which
can put out 1,000,000 volts of electricity.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_405_000
text:
Seeing through solid objects uses up a lot of
Luxray’s electricity, so the Pokémon sleeps for
long periods of time to store up energy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_406_000
text:
This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature
changes. When its bud starts to open, that means
spring is right around the corner.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_407_000
text:
The poison in its right hand is quick acting.
The poison in its left hand is slow acting.
Both are life threatening.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_415_000
text:
It ceaselessly gathers nectar from sunrise to
sundown, all for the sake of Vespiquen and
the swarm.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_416_000
text:
Vespiquen that give off more pheromones
have larger swarms of Combee attendants.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_420_000
text:
The deeper a Cherubi’s red, the more nutrients it
has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and
tastier its small ball!

label: ZKN_SHIELD_421_000
text:
Its folded petals are pretty tough. Bird Pokémon
can peck at them all they want, and Cherrim
won’t be bothered at all.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_422_000
text:
Subjecting this Pokémon to a strong force
causes it to secrete a strange purple fluid.
Though harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_423_000
text:
The softness of its body helps disperse the force
of impacts, so although its body is uncommonly
squishy, it’s also surprisingly resilient.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_425_000
text:
The gathering of many souls gave rise to this
Pokémon. During humid seasons, they seem to
appear in abundance.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_426_000
text:
It grabs people and Pokémon and carries them
off somewhere. Where do they go?
Nobody knows.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_427_000
text:
Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and
then striking with the force created by unrolling
them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_428_000
text:
Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny’s coat will
be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating
air in preparation for colder weather.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_434_000
text:
If it lifts its tail and points its rear at you, beware.
It’s about to spray you with a fluid stinky enough
to make you faint.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_435_000
text:
It digs holes in the ground to make its nest.
The stench of the fluid it lets fly from the tip
of its tail is extremely potent.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_436_000
text:
Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface
reflect the truth, according to common lore.
Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_437_000
text:
Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon
originated outside the Galar region, based on
the patterns on its body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_438_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in dry, rocky areas. As its
green spheres dry out, their dull luster increases.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_439_000
text:
It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer
and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps
like an apprentice.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_440_000
text:
Happiny’s willing to lend its precious round stone
to those it’s friendly with, but if the stone isn’t
returned, Happiny will cry and throw a tantrum.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_442_000
text:
All Spiritomb’s mischief and misdeeds compelled
a traveler to use a mysterious spell to bind
Spiritomb to an odd keystone.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_443_000
text:
Gible attacks anything that moves, and it drags
whatever it catches into the crevice that is its lair.
Despite the big mouth, Gible’s stomach is small.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_444_000
text:
Jewels are buried in the caves these Pokémon
nest in, but you’ll be torn apart by claws and
fangs the moment you enter one of these caves.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_445_000
text:
Garchomp is fast both underground and above.
It can bring down prey and return to its den
before its body has chilled from being outside.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_446_000
text:
It stores food beneath its fur. It might share
just one bite, but only if it really trusts you.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_447_000
text:
It can use waves called auras to gauge how
others are feeling. These same waves can also tell
this Pokémon about the state of the environment.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_448_000
text:
It can tell what people are thinking. Only Trainers
who have justice in their hearts can earn this
Pokémon’s trust.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_449_000
text:
This Pokémon is active during the day and passes
the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into
the sand.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_450_000
text:
When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out
the quantities of sand it has swallowed and
whips up a sandstorm.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_451_000
text:
It attacks using the claws on its tail. Once locked
in its grip, its prey is unable to move as this
Pokémon’s poison seeps in.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_452_000
text:
It’s so vicious that it’s called the Sand Demon.
Yet when confronted by Hippowdon, Drapion
keeps a low profile and will never pick a fight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_453_000
text:
Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal.
This Pokémon came into popularity after a
pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_454_000
text:
It booms out a victory croak when its prey
goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and
Seismitoad are related species.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_458_000
text:
It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and
they’ll all fight together to repel attackers.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_459_000
text:
The berries that grow around its belly are like
ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love
these berries.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_460_000
text:
This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards.
A shake of its massive body is enough to
cause whiteout conditions.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_461_000
text:
With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its
friends to find. The number of distinct signs
is said to be over 500.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_462_000
text:
It’s thought that a special magnetic field changed
the molecular structure of this Pokémon’s body,
and that’s what caused the Pokémon’s evolution.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_463_000
text:
Lickilicky can do just about anything with its
tongue, which is as dexterous as the human hand.
In contrast, Lickilicky’s use of its fingers is clumsy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_464_000
text:
It relies on its carapace to deflect incoming
attacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soon
as that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_465_000
text:
Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in
warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth
shortens them by tearing parts of them off.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_466_000
text:
In terms of electrical-energy output, Electivire
is one of the best among all Electric Pokémon.
It discharges high-voltage currents from its tails.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_467_000
text:
Living in the crater of a volcano has caused this
Pokémon’s body to resemble its environment—
it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_468_000
text:
Known as a bringer of blessings, it’s
been depicted on good-luck charms
since ancient times.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_470_000
text:
This Pokémon’s tail is blade sharp, with a
fantastic cutting edge that can slice right
though large trees.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_471_000
text:
The coldness emanating from Glaceon causes
powdery snow to form, making it quite a popular
Pokémon at ski resorts.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_473_000
text:
It looks strong, and that’s exactly what it is.
As the weather grows colder, its ice tusks
grow longer, thicker, and more impressive.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_474_000
text:
Some say an additional program made this
Pokémon evolve, but even academics can’t agree
on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_475_000
text:
Sharply attuned to others’ wishes for help, this
Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them
in battle.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_477_000
text:
With the mouth on its belly, Dusknoir swallows its
target whole. The soul is the only thing eaten—
Dusknoir disgorges the body before departing.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_478_000
text:
It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees
Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen
prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_479_000
text:
With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all
sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_506_000
text:
This Pokémon is far brighter than the average
child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it
receives or any abuse it suffers.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_507_000
text:
The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body
is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce
right off.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_508_000
text:
Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive
moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what
determines social standing among this species.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_509_000
text:
Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable
behavior come away with stinging scratches from
its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_510_000
text:
This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey
without making any sound at all. It competes with
Thievul for territory.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_517_000
text:
It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink
when it’s eating a good dream, and black when
it’s eating a nightmare.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_518_000
text:
It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to
leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible
grump when freshly roused from sleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_519_000
text:
It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many
Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness
and sincerity.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_520_000
text:
These bright Pokémon have acute memories.
Apparently delivery workers often choose them
as their partners.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_521_000
text:
This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud.
People will sit up and take notice if you become
the Trainer of one.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_524_000
text:
When it detects a noise, it starts to move.
The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon
slightly warm to the touch.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_525_000
text:
It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its
vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever
changing the direction it’s facing.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_526_000
text:
Although its energy blasts can blow away
a dump truck, they have a limitation—
they can only be fired when the sun is out.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_527_000
text:
It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about,
searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_528_000
text:
The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose
apparently led some regions to consider
Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_529_000
text:
It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the
ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so
many farmers have little love for it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_530_000
text:
Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can
tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over
90 mph.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_531_000
text:
This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with
its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’
feelings and physical conditions.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_532_000
text:
Timburr that have started carrying logs that are
about three times their size are nearly ready
to evolve.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_533_000
text:
Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not
its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this
Pokémon wields its metal beam.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_534_000
text:
When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside
its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to
pummel them with its fists.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_535_000
text:
It uses sound waves to communicate with
others of its kind. People and other Pokémon
species can’t hear its cries of warning.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_536_000
text:
On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to
the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their
bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_537_000
text:
This Pokémon is popular among the elderly,
who say the vibrations of its lumps are great
for massages.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_538_000
text:
They train in groups of five. Any member that
can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave
the group.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_539_000
text:
The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself
to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_543_000
text:
Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon
finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them
without any thought of how things might turn out.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_544_000
text:
Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and
poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll
need for evolution.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_545_000
text:
Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with
Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles,
the victor makes a meal of the loser.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_546_000
text:
Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee
and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s
highly prized by many luxury brands.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_547_000
text:
As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its
cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff
builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_548_000
text:
The deeper the color of a Petilil’s leaves, the
healthier the Pokémon is. Petilil sometimes makes
its home in a well-tended field or flowerbed.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_549_000
text:
Essential oils made from Lilligant flowers
have a sublime scent, but they’re also
staggeringly expensive.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_550_000
text:
In the past, it often appeared on the dinner
table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the
fatty side, and it’s more popular with the youth.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_551_000
text:
Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are
powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile
moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_552_000
text:
Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that
allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move
much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_553_000
text:
While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has
the patience to stay hidden under sand for days,
lying in wait for prey.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_554_000
text:
This popular symbol of good fortune will never
fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed
or pulled.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_555_000
text:
This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the
temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500
degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_556_000
text:
Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds.
They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them
a precious food source out in the desert.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_557_000
text:
It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there
are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may
move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_558_000
text:
Its thick claws are its greatest weapons.
They’re mighty enough to crack
Rhyperior’s carapace.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_559_000
text:
It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought
that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has
completely stretched out.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_560_000
text:
While mostly known for having the temperament
of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very
good care of its family, friends, and territory.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_561_000
text:
A discovery was made in the desert where
Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been
an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_562_000
text:
The spirit of a person from a bygone age became
this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching
for someone who knows its face.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_563_000
text:
There are many depictions of Cofagrigus
decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols
of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_564_000
text:
Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of
many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life
from a fossil.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_565_000
text:
This Pokémon emerges from the water in search
of prey despite the fact that it moves more
slowly on land.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_566_000
text:
Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird
Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries
and bug Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_567_000
text:
Though capable of flight, Archeops was
apparently better at hunting on the ground.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_568_000
text:
This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with
trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched
by Trubbish.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_569_000
text:
The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm
is so virulent that it can kill a weakened
creature instantly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_570_000
text:
Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and
goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua
does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_571_000
text:
Seeking to ease the burden of their solitude,
lonely Trainers tell Zoroark to show illusions
to them.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_572_000
text:
They pet each other with their tails as a form of
greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier
is a bit more boastful.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_573_000
text:
A special oil that seeps through their fur helps
them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price
at market.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_574_000
text:
Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita
can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe
it’s speaking to something only it can see.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_575_000
text:
On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s
psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just
what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_576_000
text:
A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle
went missing that same day and was never
seen again.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_577_000
text:
Many say that the special liquid covering this
Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in
the vacuum of space.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_578_000
text:
Its brain has split into two, and the two
halves rarely think alike. Its actions are
utterly unpredictable.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_579_000
text:
It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding
Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is
highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_582_000
text:
Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an
icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees
Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_583_000
text:
It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148
degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it
spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_584_000
text:
People believe this Pokémon formed when two
Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is
roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_587_000
text:
This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries.
Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much
food that it can’t fly properly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_588_000
text:
It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through
Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell—
it eats only the contents.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_589_000
text:
It charges its enemies, lances at the ready.
An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous
painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_590_000
text:
The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands
are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried,
the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_591_000
text:
Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It
tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have
been dropped on the ground.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_592_000
text:
Legend has it that the residents of a sunken
ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_593_000
text:
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky,
schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of
the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_595_000
text:
Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out
static electricity. They’re often found sticking to
Yamper’s hindquarters.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_596_000
text:
It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests
of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are
not yet good at flying.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_597_000
text:
Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings.
Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s
spikes grow big and strong.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_598_000
text:
Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon
crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes
on its feelers into the stone.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_599_000
text:
It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration
behind ancient people’s invention of the
first gears.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_600_000
text:
Many companies in the Galar region choose
Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered
the symbol of industrial technology.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_601_000
text:
The three gears that compose this Pokémon
spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t
a living creature.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_605_000
text:
This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years
ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to
exert its psychic powers.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_606_000
text:
Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields,
this Pokémon can control the memories of
its opponents.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_607_000
text:
The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs,
the brighter and eerier the flame on its
head burns.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_608_000
text:
It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp.
Once it finds someone whose death is near,
it will trail quietly after them.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_609_000
text:
In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of
lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—
or so it’s said.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_610_000
text:
They play with each other by knocking their large
tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but
they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_611_000
text:
Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s
favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents,
stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_612_000
text:
While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if
angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams
are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_613_000
text:
It sniffles before performing a move, using its
frosty snot to provide an icy element to any
move that needs it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_614_000
text:
It swims energetically through frigid seas.
When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater
with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_615_000
text:
When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn
into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never
seen during summer.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_616_000
text:
It has a strange physiology that responds to
electricity. When together with Karrablast,
Shelmet evolves for some reason.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_617_000
text:
Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep
itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in
bands of membrane.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_618_000
text:
For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly
when it emits a strong electric current from the
yellow markings on its body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_619_000
text:
Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce.
Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly
will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_620_000
text:
Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this
Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into
tiny pieces.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_621_000
text:
Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up
residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon,
treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_622_000
text:
This Pokémon was created from clay. It received
orders from its master many thousands of years
ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_623_000
text:
There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual
motion machine that produces limitless energy,
but this belief hasn’t been proven.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_624_000
text:
A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a
Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently,
dreaming of one day taking the lead.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_625_000
text:
Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and
Fraxure over places where sharpening stones
can be found.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_626_000
text:
These Pokémon live in herds of about 20
individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will
lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_627_000
text:
A combative Pokémon, it’s ready to pick a fight
with anyone. It has talons that can crush
hard berries.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_628_000
text:
Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and
belligerent, it’s Corviknight that’s taken
the role of transportation in Galar.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_629_000
text:
Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too
small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed
down to younger ones in the nest.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_630_000
text:
They adorn themselves with bones. There seem
to be fashion trends among them, as different
bones come into and fall out of popularity.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_631_000
text:
A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the
hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour
their insides.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_632_000
text:
With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can
crunch their way through rock. They work
together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_633_000
text:
Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly
biting at everything it touches, trying to keep
track of its surroundings.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_634_000
text:
Their two heads will fight each other over a
single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in
scars even without battling others.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_635_000
text:
The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into
the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their
target goes down.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_636_000
text:
Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire
from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators
and scare prey.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_637_000
text:
This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of
raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as
a deity of fire.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_638_000
text:
From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon
radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will
calm even vicious foes.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_639_000
text:
In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against
humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_640_000
text:
It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick
movements, slicing them up with its horns.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_643_000
ZKN_SHIELD_644_000
text:
Mythology tells us that if people lose the
righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms
will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_646_000
text:
It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over
ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its
cellular structure.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_647_000
text:
They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles
and fully develop the horn on its forehead
before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_659_000
text:
It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of
Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby
digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_660_000
text:
The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally
well. People used to make heavy winter clothing
from fur shed by this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_661_000
text:
When this Pokémon gets excited, its body
temperature increases sharply. If you touch a
Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_662_000
text:
Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and
aggressive. These Pokémon fight among
themselves over feeding grounds.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_663_000
text:
Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to
310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks,
giving the prey no chance to escape.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_674_000
text:
Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously,
Pancham’s always giving others a glare.
But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_675_000
text:
Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of
its opponents. It strikes with punches that can
turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_677_000
text:
There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a
wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be
controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_678_000
text:
The defensive instinct of the males is strong.
It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their
partners that they unleash their full power.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_679_000
text:
The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the
true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it
drains people’s lives away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_680_000
text:
The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly
alternating between offense and defense to
bring down their prey.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_681_000
text:
Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate
others. It once used its powers to force people
and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_682_000
text:
The scent its body gives off enraptures those
who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of
love for Spritzee.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_683_000
text:
The scents Aromatisse can produce range from
sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells
that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_684_000
text:
The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes
Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out
sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_685_000
text:
Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft
to the touch and lighter than it looks.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_686_000
text:
By exposing foes to the blinking of its
luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them,
and then it seizes the chance to flee.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_687_000
text:
It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played
a role in certain history-changing events.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_688_000
text:
If the two don’t work well together, both their
offense and defense fall apart. Without good
teamwork, they won’t survive.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_689_000
text:
Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep
watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start
to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_690_000
text:
Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it
can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean
and avoid being detected by enemies.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_691_000
text:
Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking
the plume on its head out above the ocean’s
surface and bathing it in sunlight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_692_000
text:
By detonating gas that accumulates in its right
claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet.
This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_693_000
text:
Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches
projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a
Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_694_000
text:
The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity
generation. Interruption of that process
stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_695_000
text:
One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill
outspread is all it would take to produce enough
electricity to power a city.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_696_000
text:
This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered.
It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer
just by playing around.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_697_000
text:
A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will
demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the
ancient world.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_698_000
text:
Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone
extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes
be found frozen in ice.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_699_000
text:
When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate
freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_700_000
text:
There’s a Galarian fairy tale that describes
a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful
dragon Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_701_000
text:
It always strikes a pose before going for its
finishing move. Sometimes opponents take
advantage of that time to counterattack.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_702_000
text:
Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on
its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other
electric Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_703_000
text:
It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s
a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering
Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_704_000
text:
Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as
Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into
hiding. This is how they’ve survived.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_705_000
text:
The lump on its back contains its tiny brain.
It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_706_000
text:
Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its
horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any
blow from a heavyweight boxer.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_707_000
text:
Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping
its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so
much that its head needed to look like one, too.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_708_000
text:
With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to
lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost
among the trees.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_709_000
text:
Small roots that extend from the tips of this
Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the
forest and give Trevenant control over them.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_710_000
text:
The light that streams out from the holes in the
pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people
and Pokémon that see it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_711_000
text:
In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist
will come knocking. Whoever answers the door
will be swept off to the afterlife.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_712_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold.
It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg
by freezing its feet in place.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_713_000
text:
As Avalugg moves about during the day,
the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon’s
body returns to a pristine state overnight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_714_000
text:
No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s
ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it
generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_715_000
text:
Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies
with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone.
Its fangs finish the fight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_722_000
text:
During the day, it builds up energy via
photosynthesis. At night, it flies silently
through the sky, on the prowl for prey.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_723_000
text:
It never slacks when it comes to the task of
cleaning its feathers. Thorough preening keeps it
looking spiffy and its blade quills nice and sharp.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_724_000
text:
In a tenth of a second, it can nock and fire an
arrow quill, piercing an opponent’s weak point
before they notice what’s happening.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_725_000
text:
Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will
result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws.
Be careful.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_726_000
text:
When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s
fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell
blazes hotter.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_727_000
text:
Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its
most notable trait, but the way it helps out small
Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_728_000
text:
If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons,
they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for
these Pokémon to develop their skills.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_729_000
text:
On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance
with one another to the singing of the Primarina
that’s leading them.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_730_000
text:
For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing
and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize
the audience.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_736_000
text:
It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest
floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_737_000
text:
Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats
into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores
the electricity for later use.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_738_000
text:
If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery,
a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered
beams of electricity.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_742_000
text:
An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that
opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can
glide around the attack and strike back.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_743_000
text:
Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or
rained on. In the cloudy Galar region,
they are very seldom seen.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_744_000
text:
This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking
the ground with the rocks on its neck. The
moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_745_000
text:
With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually
backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are
always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_746_000
text:
When it senses danger, its eyes tear up.
The sparkle of its tears signals other
Wishiwashi to gather.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_747_000
text:
Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie
of the Galar region have not yet figured out
that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_748_000
text:
Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so
toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still
be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_749_000
text:
It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all
over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk
on rough terrain without slipping.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_750_000
text:
Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry
over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest
or sleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_751_000
text:
Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it
comes onto land in search of food, it takes
water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_752_000
text:
It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them
inside its bubble and letting them eat any
leftover food.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_753_000
text:
During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and
sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around
at night.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_754_000
text:
The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and
super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if
Lurantis gathers light first.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_755_000
text:
Morelull live in forests that stay dark even
during the day. They scatter flickering spores
that put enemies to sleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_756_000
text:
If you see a light deep in a forest at night,
don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall
fast asleep.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_757_000
text:
This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey
and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the
prey even realizes Salandit is there.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_758_000
text:
The winner of competitions between Salazzle
is decided by which one has the most male
Salandit with it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_759_000
text:
The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may
be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is
flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_760_000
text:
The moves it uses to take down its prey would
make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued
prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_761_000
text:
When under attack, it secretes a sweet
and delicious sweat. The scent only calls
more enemies to it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_762_000
text:
Any Corvisquire that pecks at this
Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from
its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_763_000
text:
A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s
legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and
soul that will never heal.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_764_000
text:
These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear
different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has
its own individual scent.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_765_000
text:
It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes
across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will
gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_766_000
text:
Passimian live in groups of about 20, with
each member performing an assigned role.
Through cooperation, the group survives.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_767_000
text:
Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the
lookout for danger. They scatter the moment
they detect an enemy’s presence.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_768_000
text:
They live in sunken ships or in holes in the
seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct
battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_769_000
text:
Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes
control of anyone who puts their hand into its
mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_770_000
text:
This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates
water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like
shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_771_000
text:
It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist,
allowing it to stay on land for days without
drying up.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_772_000
text:
It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth.
The mask placed upon it limits its power in order
to keep it under control.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_000
text:
The final factor needed to release this
Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond
with a Trainer it trusts.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_776_000
text:
Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes
explosive compounds to develop in its shell.
Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_777_000
text:
When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes
its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges
electricity indiscriminately.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_778_000
text:
There was a scientist who peeked under
Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research.
The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_780_000
text:
Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until
it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a
gale and flattens everything around.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_781_000
text:
After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It
catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_782_000
text:
Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with
others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s
become as hard as metal.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_783_000
text:
Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its
scales together and roars. Its sharp claws
shred the opposition.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_784_000
text:
Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors
wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_789_000
text:
Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious,
often placing itself in danger. If things start to
look dicey, it teleports away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_790_000
text:
It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate,
frantically building up energy within its core as
preparation for evolution.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_791_000
text:
Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That
Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light
radiates boundlessly from it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_792_000
text:
It steals the light from its surroundings and then
becomes the full moon, showering its own light
across the night sky.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_800_000
text:
It needs light to survive, and it goes on a
rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will
cut anything to pieces.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_802_000
text:
This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow,
so it went undiscovered for a long time.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_807_000
text:
Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs.
Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and
thunder echoes.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_808_000
text:
They live as a group, but when the time comes,
one strong Meltan will absorb all the others
and evolve.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_809_000
text:
Centrifugal force is behind the punches of
Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said
to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_810_000
text:
It attacks with rapid beats of its stick.
As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets
more and more pumped.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_811_000
text:
When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it
gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even
notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_812_000
text:
The one with the best drumming techniques
becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle
disposition and values harmony among its group.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_813_000
text:
It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and
one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these
pads radiate tremendous heat.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_814_000
text:
It kicks berries right off the branches of trees
and then juggles them with its feet, practicing
its footwork.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_815_000
text:
It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it
gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts
showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_816_000
text:
When it gets wet, its skin changes color,
and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if
it were camouflaged.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_817_000
text:
Highly intelligent but also very lazy,
it keeps enemies out of its territory
