by laying traps everywhere.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_818_000
text:
Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’
weak points so it can precisely blast them with
water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_819_000
text:
It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made
it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on
farms, searching for yet more berries.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_820_000
text:
Common throughout the Galar region, this
Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew
through the toughest of berry shells.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_821_000
text:
Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied
Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest
opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_822_000
text:
The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it
how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_823_000
text:
With their great intellect and flying skills, these
Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar
region’s airborne taxi service.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_824_000
text:
Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs
on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_825_000
text:
As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic
abilities to monitor the outside world and
prepare for evolution.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_826_000
text:
It emits psychic energy to observe and study
what’s around it—and what’s around it can
include things over six miles away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_827_000
text:
Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by
stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with
swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_828_000
text:
With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes
around stealing food and eggs. Boltund
is its natural enemy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_829_000
text:
It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous
song. This delightful display has charmed many
into raising this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_830_000
text:
The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be
spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar
regional specialty.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_831_000
text:
If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be
able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this
Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_832_000
text:
Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the
opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_833_000
text:
It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard
horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this
Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_834_000
text:
This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck
to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and
take them down.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_835_000
text:
This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with
their work because it wants treats. As it runs,
it crackles with electricity.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_836_000
text:
It sends electricity through its legs to boost their
strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks
50 mph.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_837_000
text:
It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough,
rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_838_000
text:
By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over
18 mph. The temperature of the flames it
breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_839_000
text:
While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal
will burn bright red, sending off sparks that
scorch the surrounding area.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_840_000
text:
As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not
only does the apple serve as its food source, but
the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_841_000
text:
It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a
powerful acid. It can also change its shape
into that of an apple.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_842_000
text:
Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the
skin on its back is especially yummy. Children
used to have it as a snack.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_843_000
text:
It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy
is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_844_000
text:
Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand
out of its sand sac more efficiently.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_845_000
text:
This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole.
Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to
swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_846_000
text:
After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become
extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant
swallows it up.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_847_000
text:
It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging
forward at speeds of over 100 knots before
ramming prey and spearing into them.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_848_000
text:
It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison
to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it
can cause a tingling paralysis.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_849_000
text:
This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon
chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it
might contain.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_850_000
text:
It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking
them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will
voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_851_000
text:
While its burning body is already dangerous on
its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has
large and very sharp fangs.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_852_000
text:
Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed
when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back.
It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_853_000
text:
Searching for an opponent to test its skills
against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle
is over, it returns to the sea.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_854_000
text:
The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its
home is a famous piece of antique tableware.
Many forgeries are in circulation.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_855_000
text:
Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking
for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself
into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_856_000
text:
If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it
will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas
without people.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_857_000
text:
Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to
get them to quiet down. One blow from those
braids would knock out a professional boxer.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_858_000
text:
If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn
apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon
is also known as the Forest Witch.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_859_000
text:
It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things
and feasting on the negative energy of the
frustrated occupants.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_860_000
text:
With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the
woods. Some believe it to have the power to
make crops grow.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_861_000
text:
Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs
unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring
them as tentacles would.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_862_000
text:
It evolved after experiencing numerous fights.
While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that
would make any opponent flinch.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_863_000
text:
After many battles, it evolved dangerous
claws that come together to form daggers
when extended.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_864_000
text:
Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body
surrounding its soul. You’ll become
stiff as stone if you touch it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_865_000
text:
After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield,
it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek
stalk is both weapon and food.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_866_000
text:
Its amusing movements make it very popular.
It releases its psychic power from the pattern
on its belly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_867_000
text:
Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be
shown the horrific memories behind the picture
carved into it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_868_000
text:
They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery
is guaranteed success and good fortune.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_000
text:
When Alcremie is content, the cream it
secretes from its hands becomes sweeter
and richer.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_870_000
text:
The six of them work together as one Pokémon.
Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they
constantly change their formation as they fight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_871_000
text:
It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets
broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for
at least three hours.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_872_000
text:
It eats snow that piles up on the ground.
The more snow it eats, the bigger and more
impressive the spikes on its back grow.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_873_000
text:
It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields
and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings,
causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_874_000
text:
Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific
time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in
a circle.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_875_000
text:
This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool
with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single
hair into the sea to lure in prey.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_876_000
text:
Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions
of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the
source of its strength.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_877_000
text:
It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if
they’re precious treasures. No matter how much
it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_878_000
text:
If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon
will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the
rain, turning a vibrant green color.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_879_000
text:
These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have
incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush
giant rocks into powder.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_880_000
text:
The powerful muscles in its tail generate its
electricity. Compared to its lower body,
its upper half is entirely too small.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_881_000
text:
This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and
was able to preserve food with the ice on its
body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_882_000
text:
Its mighty legs are capable of running at
speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon
can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_883_000
text:
The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but
breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go
extinct anyway.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_884_000
text:
The special metal that composes its body is very
light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility.
It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_885_000
text:
If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child
could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help
it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_886_000
text:
Without a Dreepy to place on its head and
care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute
any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_887_000
text:
Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s
horns eagerly look forward to being launched out
at Mach speeds.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_888_000
text:
This Pokémon has slumbered for many years.
Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others
say the two Pokémon are rivals.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_889_000
text:
This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of
a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot
that it ever existed.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_890_000
text:
It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years
ago. There seems to be a connection between
this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_891_000
text:
If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head,
its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up
from the depths of its belly.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_892_000
text:
Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this
Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs
and refining its moves.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_893_000
text:
Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they
become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants
of the forest grow.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_894_000
text:
Its entire body is made up of a single organ that
generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable
of creating all Galar’s electricity.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_895_000
text:
Its body is composed of crystallized dragon
energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of
every dragon Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_896_000
text:
Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and
the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times
harder than diamond.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_897_000
text:
As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs
the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves
silence and solitude.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_898_000
text:
Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled
over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to
cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_003_999
text:
Huge amounts of pollen burst from it with the
force of a volcanic eruption. Breathing in too
much of the pollen can cause fainting.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_006_999
text:
The flame inside its body burns hotter than
3,600 degrees Fahrenheit. When Charizard
roars, that temperature climbs even higher.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_009_999
text:
Water fired from this Pokémon’s central main
cannon has enough power to blast a hole into
a mountain.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_012_999
text:
Once it has opponents trapped in a tornado that
could blow away a 10-ton truck, it finishes them
off with its poisonous scales.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_001
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is proof that the two traveled
across many regions together.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_002
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is proof that the two traveled
throughout the Hoenn region together.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_003
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is proof that the two traveled
throughout the Sinnoh region together.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_004
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is proof that the two traveled
throughout the Unova region together.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_005
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is proof that the two traveled
throughout the Kalos region together

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_006
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is proof that the two traveled
throughout the Alola region together.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_007
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is a precious symbol of a
fateful encounter.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_009
text:
This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer’s cap.
The cap is a precious symbol that travels across
different regions with Pikachu.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_025_999
text:
When it smashes its opponents with its bolt-
shaped tail, it delivers a surge of electricity
equivalent to a lightning strike.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_026_001
text:
This Pokémon rides on its tail while it uses
its psychic powers to levitate. It attacks with
star-shaped thunderbolts.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_027_001
text:
It lives in snowy mountains on southern islands.
When a blizzard rolls in, this Pokémon hunkers
down in the snow to avoid getting blown away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_028_001
text:
Many people climb snowy mountains, hoping to
see the icy spikes of these Pokémon glistening
in the light of dawn.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_037_001
text:
If you observe its curly hairs through
a microscope, you’ll see small ice
particles springing up.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_038_001
text:
While it will guide travelers who get lost on a
snowy mountain down to the mountain’s base,
it won’t forgive anyone who harms nature.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_050_001
text:
Its three hairs change shape depending on
Diglett’s mood. They’re a useful communication
tool among these Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_051_001
text:
The three of them get along very well.
Through their formidable teamwork, they
defeat powerful opponents.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_052_001
text:
Deeply proud and keenly smart, this Pokémon
moves with cunning during battle and relentlessly
attacks enemies’ weak points.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_052_002
text:
These daring Pokémon have coins on their
foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder
coins garner more respect among Meowth.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_052_999
text:
Its body has grown incredibly long and the coin
on its forehead has grown incredibly large—all
thanks to Gigantamax power.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_053_001
text:
This Pokémon is one tough opponent. Not only
does it have formidable physical abilities, but it’s
also not above fighting dirty.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_068_999
text:
One of these Pokémon once used its
immeasurable strength to lift a large ship that
was in trouble. It then carried the ship to port.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_077_001
text:
This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read
the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there,
it promptly hides away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_078_001
text:
Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily
through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic
power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_079_001
text:
Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a
plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have
developed a spicy flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_080_002
text:
If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the
Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic
liquid from the tip of its shell.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_083_001
text:
The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the
Galar region. Farfetch’d that adapted to these
stalks took on a unique form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_094_999
text:
It lays traps, hoping to steal the lives of those it
catches. If you stand in front of its mouth, you’ll
hear your loved ones’ voices calling out to you.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_099_999
text:
The bubbles it spews out are strongly alkaline.
Any opponents hit by them will have their bodies
quickly melted away.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_103_001
text:
This Pokémon’s psychic powers aren’t as strong
as they once were. The head on this Exeggutor’s
tail scans surrounding areas with weak telepathy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_105_001
text:
The cursed flames that light up the bone carried
by this Pokémon are said to cause both mental
and physical pain that will never fade.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_110_001
text:
Long ago, during a time when droves of factories
fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed
into this form for some reason.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_122_001
text:
It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its
feet. It’ll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a
frozen floor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_131_999
text:
It surrounds itself with a huge ring of gathered ice
particles. It uses the ring to smash any icebergs
that might impede its graceful swimming.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_133_999
text:
Having gotten even friendlier and more innocent,
Eevee tries to play with anyone around, only
to end up crushing them with its immense body.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_143_999
text:
Terrifyingly strong, this Pokémon is the size of
a mountain—and moves about as much as one
as well.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_144_001
text:
Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that
can immobilize opponents as if they had been
frozen solid.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_145_001
text:
One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a
dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs
through the mountains at over 180 mph.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_146_001
text:
The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire
around this Pokémon is what inspired the
name Moltres.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_199_001
text:
While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon
combines its internal toxins with what it’s eaten,
creating strange potions.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_222_001
text:
Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient
kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others’
life-force through its branches.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_263_001
text:
Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon,
it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon
its surroundings.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_264_001
text:
This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly
challenge opponents stronger than itself.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_421_001
text:
The faint scent that emanates from its full
blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_422_001
text:
Its appearance changes depending on the
environment. One theory suggests that living
in cold seas causes Shellos to take on this form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_423_001
text:
Its body is covered in a sticky slime. It’s very
susceptible to dehydration, so it can’t spend
too much time on land.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_479_001
text:
This form of Rotom enjoys making mischief by
turning up the heat. It will gleefully burn your
favorite outfit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_479_002
text:
This Rotom has possessed a washing machine
that uses a special motor. It blasts out water to
get enemies to back down.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_479_003
text:
When it’s like this, Rotom likes to play pranks
that are freezing cold. You may find it’s turned
the bath you just filled to solid ice!

label: ZKN_SHIELD_479_004
text:
This Rotom has taken over a fan that has
a special motor. Its gusts of wind blow its
opponents away!

label: ZKN_SHIELD_479_005
text:
In this form, Rotom focuses its antics on plants.
Any flowers you were growing are going to
get mowed down.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_550_001
text:
Known for their violence, these Pokémon
have the most fights with schools of red-
striped Basculin.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_554_001
text:
The colder they get, the more energetic they are.
They freeze their breath to make snowballs,
using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_555_001
text:
When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as
still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind
and spirit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_555_002
text:
Though it has a gentle disposition, it’s also very
strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its
head before going for a headbutt.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_555_003
text:
Darmanitan takes this form when enraged.
It won’t stop spewing flames until its rage
has settled, even if its body starts to melt.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_562_001
text:
It’s said that this Pokémon was formed when an
ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_569_999
text:
It sprays toxic gas from its mouth and fingers. If
the gas engulfs you, the toxins will seep in all the
way down to your bones.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_618_001
text:
Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in
the mud. When prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps
its jagged steel fins down on them.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_646_001
text:
It has foreseen that a world of truth will arrive
for people and Pokémon. It strives to protect
that future.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_646_002
text:
The sameness of Zekrom’s and Kyurem’s genes
allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can
now use the power of both electricity and ice.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_647_001
text:
The power that lay hidden in its body now covers
its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice
through anything.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_678_001
text:
If it doesn’t hold back when it unleashes its
psychic power, it can tear apart a tanker.
Its unfriendliness is part of its charm.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_681_001
text:
Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash
reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually
drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_710_001
text:
Small Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of
areas where few lost souls lingered.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_710_002
text:
Large Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of
areas where many lost souls lingered.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_710_003
text:
Massive Pumpkaboo are said to be the product
of areas where a great number of lost
souls lingered.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_711_001
text:
A small-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into
a small-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions
also get passed on to its descendants.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_711_002
text:
A large-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into
a large-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions
also get passed on to its descendants.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_711_003
text:
A supersized Pumpkaboo evolves into
a supersized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions
also get passed on to its descendants.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_744_001
text:
This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking
the ground with the rocks on its neck. The
moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_745_001
text:
It’s invigorated by powerful opponents—the
stronger the better. A full-force headbutt from
one of these Lycanroc can shatter giant boulders.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_745_002
text:
These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious
qualities. Their temperamental nature makes
them a difficult species to raise.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_746_001
text:
When facing tough opponents, they get into
formation. But if they get wounded in battle,
they’ll scatter and become solitary again.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_001
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Fighting-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_002
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Flying-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_003

It has the ability to change its type based

Poison-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_006

Bug-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_007

It has the ability to change its type based

Ghost-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_008

It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Steel-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_009

It has the ability to change its type based

Fire-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_010

It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Water-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_011
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Grass-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_012
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Electric-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_013
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Psychic-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_014
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Ice-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_015
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Dragon-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_016
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Dark-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_773_017
text:
It has the ability to change its type based
on the memory it’s holding. This is its
Fairy-type form.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_778_001
text:
Its disguise made from an old rag allowed it to
avoid an attack, but the impact broke the neck of
the disguise. Now everyone knows it’s a Mimikyu.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_800_001
text:
Necrozma has attached itself to Solgaleo.
It siphons away its host’s limitless energy,
exploiting that energy to fuel a rampage.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_800_002
text:
When Necrozma latches on to Lunala, it becomes
vicious, seeing enemies everywhere it looks.
It will burn the world with lasers.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_809_999
text:
It can send electric beams streaking out from the
hole in its belly. The beams’ tremendous energy
can vaporize an opponent in one shot.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_812_999
text:
Rillaboom has become one with its forest of
drums and continues to lay down beats that
shake all of Galar.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_815_999
text:
Gigantamax energy can sometimes cause the
diameter of this Pokémon’s fireball to exceed
300 feet.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_818_999
text:
It has excellent sniping skills. Shooting a berry
rolling along over nine miles away is a piece of
cake for this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_823_999
text:
The eight feathers on its back are called blade
birds, and they can launch off its body to attack
foes independently.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_826_999
text:
If it were to utilize every last bit of its power,
it could control the minds of every living being
in its vicinity.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_834_999
text:
In the Galar region, there’s a tale about
this Pokémon chewing up a mountain and
using the rubble to stop a flood.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_839_999
text:
When Galar was hit by a harsh cold wave, this
Pokémon served as a giant heating stove and
saved many lives.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_841_999
text:
If it stretches its neck, the strong aroma of its
nectar pours out. The scent is so sickeningly
sweet that one whiff makes other Pokémon faint.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_842_999
text:
Due to Gigantamax energy, this Pokémon’s
nectar has thickened. The increased viscosity lets
the nectar absorb more damage than before.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_844_999
text:
Sand swirls around its body with such speed and
power that it could pulverize a skyscraper.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_845_001
text:
The slightest shock is sometimes enough to get
this Pokémon to spit out the Arrokuda
lodged in its throat.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_845_002
text:
The half-swallowed Pikachu is so startled that
it isn’t struggling yet, but it’s still looking for a
chance to strike back.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_849_001
text:
It has an electrical organ on its chest. While
generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with
what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_849_999
text:
Out of control after its own poison penetrated its
brain, it tears across the land in a rampage,
contaminating the earth with toxic sweat.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_851_999
text:
The heat that comes off a Gigantamax
Centiskorch may destabilize air currents.
Sometimes it can even cause storms.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_854_001
text:
It absorbs the life-force of those who drink it.
It waits patiently, but opportunities are fleeting—
it tastes so bad that it gets spat out immediately.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_855_001
text:
When angered, it launches tea from its body
at the offender’s mouth. The tea causes
strong chills if swallowed.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_858_999
text:
Beams like lightning shoot down from its
tentacles. It’s known to some as the
Raging Goddess.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_861_999
text:
Gigantamax energy has caused more hair to
sprout all over its body. With the added strength,
it can jump over the world’s tallest building.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_001
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
a sweet and tart flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_002
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
an aromatic flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_003
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
a refreshing flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_004
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
a sour flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_005
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
a salty flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_006
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
a mixed flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_007
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
a bitter flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_008
text:
The cells that compose its cream fluctuated
suddenly during evolution, giving the cream
a complex flavor.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_869_999
text:
It launches swarms of missiles, each made of
cream and loaded with 100,000 kilocalories.
Get hit by one of these, and your head will swim.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_875_001
text:
The hair on its head connects to the surface of its
brain. When this Pokémon has something on its
mind, its hair chills the air around it.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_876_001
text:
They diligently serve people and Pokémon
so they can gather feelings of gratitude.
The females are particularly good at babysitting.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_877_001
text:
Hunger hormones affect its temperament.
Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to
all manner of evil deeds.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_879_999
text:
After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its
massive nose can utterly demolish large
structures with a single smashing blow.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_884_999
text:
The hardness of its cells is exceptional, even
among Steel types. It also has a body structure
that’s resistant to earthquakes.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_888_001
text:
Able to cut down anything with a single strike,
it became known as the Fairy King’s Sword,
and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_889_001
text:
Now that it’s equipped with its shield, it can
shrug off impressive blows, including the attacks
of Dynamax Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_890_001
text:
Infinite amounts of energy pour from
this Pokémon’s enlarged core, warping
the surrounding space-time.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_890_999
text:
Infinite amounts of energy pour from
this Pokémon’s enlarged core, warping
the surrounding space-time.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_892_001
text:
This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in
defeating foes by raining many blows down on
them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_892_999
text:
The energy released by this Pokémon’s fists forms
shock waves that can blow away Dynamax
Pokémon in just one hit.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_892_998
text:
All it takes is a glare from this Pokémon to take
the lives of those with evil in their hearts—or so
they say.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_893_001
text:
This Zarude’s special strength stems from its love
and care for an orphaned human child that the
Pokémon has raised since the child’s infancy.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_898_001
text:
It’s said that this Pokémon once moved a large
forest—and all the Pokémon living there—to a
new location overnight.

label: ZKN_SHIELD_898_002
text:
Legend says that by using its power to see all
events from past to future, this Pokémon saved
the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.
